blocks.description: What depends on the answer, at most 1000 characters.

missing.description: On a multi-get, always present: the ids, as sent, that are malformed, unknown, of another person's mission, or that the caller may not read, in the request's order. Absent on a page.

next.description: The cursor of the next page, absent on the last and on a multi-get.

replayed.description: The request repeated one already recorded; nothing changed.

open_decisions.description: The caller's open decisions in the read's workspaces.

read_at.description: When the summary was read. The ETag leaves it out.

states.description: The count by the mission's state as a reader sees it now: delivered once a pull request that closes its issue merged and no session works on it since, else its newest session's, none without one; the largest first.

total.description: The missions the page lists with the same filters.

workspaces.description: The count by workspace id, the largest first.

first_plan.description: The first plan that plan_session published on this mission.

plan.description: The plan a session published last; a session that never published one changes nothing.

plan_added.description: Steps of plan that plan_session's first_plan did not hold.

plan_removed.description: Steps of plan_session's first_plan that plan no longer holds; another session's steps never show here.

plan_session.description: The id of the session that published plan, empty when no session published one.

key.description: The mission key: issue-<n> once the agent declared an issue, else branch:<branch>. At most 200 printable characters without whitespace.

repository.description: The repository the agent works in, as its host reads it from the origin remote. It is compared exactly; absent names the empty repository.

runs.description: The mission owner's 20 newest runs of the mission, by its repository and key, the latest start first (agency/mission-runs).

sessions.description: The 20 sessions that synced last, newest first.

for_you.description: Whether the caller owns the mission.

issue.description: The issue an issue-<n> key names.

open_decisions.description: How many decisions of the mission are open.

missing.description: On a multi-get, always present: the ids, as sent, that are malformed, unknown or that the caller may not read, in the request's order. Absent on a page.

next.description: The cursor of the next page, absent on the last and on a multi-get.

commit.description: The commit a succeeded build left or a succeeded rebase moved the change to.

findings.description: How many findings a succeeded review or audit reported.

issue_number.description: The issue an issue-<n> key names.

key.description: Stable step key: at most 200 printable characters without whitespace, distinct within the plan.

text.description: One line, 1 to 300 characters, not blank, without control characters.

field.description: On a validation refusal: the JSON path of the member that breaks its rule, as plan.steps[2].text or session for the path's session id.

problem.description: On a validation refusal: the rule the member breaks: missing, blank, too long, too many, NUL character, control character, whitespace or unprintable character, unknown value, duplicate, not an id, not a session id of the engine, present while the state is not waiting, present while the state is not failed, or out of range.

reason.description: invalid, denied, client, owner_only, workspace.other, mission.missing, decision.missing, message.missing, revision.conflict, record.exists, idempotency.mismatch, decision.closed, message.closed, run.not_found, run.denied, run.closed or run.kind_mismatch.

branch.description: The branch of the mission's newest session.

for_you.description: Whether the caller owns the mission.

issue_number.description: The issue an issue-<n> key names.

stage.description: The loop stage of the mission's newest session.

state.description: The mission's state as a reader sees it now: delivered once a pull request that closes its issue merged and no session works on it since, else its newest session's; absent when it has neither.

reason.description: Why the last one failed: one line, at most 256 characters.

branch.description: One line, at most 256 characters, without control characters. Absent keeps the stored branch.

decisions.description: At most 20 decision ids the session asked, to bind to it. An id the caller does not hold is ignored, and a repeated one counts once; named_decisions in the answer says where each held one stands.

delivered.description: At most 100 messages the session received since its last sync. A message id the caller does not hold is ignored, and a repeated one counts once.

engine.description: The host that runs the agent: 1 to 32 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, such as claude-code or codex. The session id starts with it and a colon.

error.description: Only when state is failed: the error, at most 1 KiB.

event.description: The host event: 1 to 32 lowercase letters or underscores, such as session_start, post_tool_use, stop, wait or stop_failure. It is kept for display; only a wait changes what a sync writes.

last_message.description: The agent's last message, at most 4096 characters, sent on stop. Absent keeps the stored one.

last_prompt.description: The last request the person sent the session, at most 4096 characters. Absent or empty keeps the stored one; each request replaces the one before.

missed_syncs.description: The syncs of the session that failed since the last one that succeeded. It replaces the stored report whole; absent keeps it.

model.description: One line, at most 200 characters, without control characters. Absent keeps the stored model.

observed_at.description: When the host observed this state. An older observation than the stored one changes nothing but the acknowledgements and replies, and creates no mission.

plan.description: The whole plan, or null when it did not change.

replies.description: At most 20 replies, to distinct messages. A reply never refuses the sync: replies in the answer says what became of each one.

session_url.description: The address where the owner opens the session on its host's web interface: https, on claude.ai, at most 512 bytes. Absent keeps the stored one; an empty string clears it.

stage.description: The contribution loop stage the session's change is at: talk, declare, show, code, check, prove, validate or merge. Absent keeps the stored stage.

state.description: working, handed_back, waiting, failed or ended: the host closed the session or the user quit.

usage.description: The tokens the session used so far, cumulative for the session and its subagents. It replaces the stored usage whole; absent keeps it.

wait_until.description: Present exactly when state is waiting: the end of the wait. A time more than 15 minutes ahead counts as 15 minutes ahead. Once it passes, every read reports the session handed_back.

decisions.description: The mission's decisions whose answer no session received yet, open or answered, at most 50.

inbox.description: The mission's messages no session received yet, oldest first, at most 20, among them the answers to its decisions.

min_interval_ms.description: The least time between two syncs of one session.

named_decisions.description: One entry for each decision the sync named that the caller holds, whatever its mission and state, in the order named.

replies.description: One entry for each reply the sync carried, in order.

session.description: The session as it stands after the sync, on its own mission.

cache_read_tokens.description: Input tokens read from the prompt cache, 0 to 10^12.

cache_write_tokens.description: Input tokens written to the prompt cache, 0 to 10^12.

input_tokens.description: Input tokens read neither from nor into the prompt cache, 0 to 10^12.

id.description: The mission id; empty when an older sync names a mission the caller does not hold.

open_decisions.description: The mission's decisions no one answered yet, oldest first, at most 50.

plan.description: The mission's current plan: the plan the session that published last sent, empty when none did.

sheet.description: At most 4 KiB of text: the mission, its current plan, the open decisions and the checkpoint content. It carries no message: inbox carries each waiting message in full, answers included.

message.description: The message id: 1 to 64 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens. A reply to an id the workspace holds no message under is refused with message.not_found.

info.description: Immutable portable audit attestations, agent sessions, and the model relay.
info.title: Putnami Agency API

put.description:
Record one immutable workspace-scoped audit attestation. Duplicate keys return the existing record. The workspace is derived exclusively from the authenticated scope_ref.workspace_id claim, and the caller must be a member of it: a person needs delivery.run.submit at that workspace, and a workspace key acts only in its own workspace.

Required scopes: agency.audit.

400.description: Invalid attestation

403.description: Missing audit scope or workspace claim, or the caller may not act on the claimed workspace

500.description: Internal Agency error, or workspace authorization is unavailable

post.description:
Resolve an ordered batch of workspace-scoped audit attestations. The workspace is derived exclusively from the authenticated scope_ref.workspace_id claim, and the caller must be a member of it: a person needs agency.index.read at that workspace, and a workspace key acts only in its own workspace.

Required scopes: agency.audit.

400.description: Invalid lookup

403.description: Missing audit scope or workspace claim, or the caller may not act on the claimed workspace

500.description: Internal Agency error, or workspace authorization is unavailable

post.description: Start the rebase of one Delivery rebase job on the routine of the Putnami user it acts for (agency/gateway): the gateway records a rebase run on that person's mission branch:<head ref> and fires their rebase trigger, or their Putnami routine, with Delivery's rebase request, never another person's. started is true with the run and the claude.ai session link when the routine accepted; otherwise reason is no_trigger, no_person, disabled or unavailable. The same job starts one run: a repeat answers it and fires nothing. Service-to-service only: exact-audience Google ID token from an allowlisted dispatcher.

400.description: Malformed rebase request

403.description: The caller is not an allowlisted dispatcher

503.description: The caller could not be verified

post.description: Start the review of one pull request head on the routine of the Putnami user it acts for (agency/gateway): the gateway records a review run on that person's mission branch:<head ref> and fires their review trigger, or their Putnami routine, with the review request and the run id the routine reports, never another person's. started is true with the run and the claude.ai session link when the routine accepted; otherwise reason is no_trigger, no_person, disabled or unavailable. One head of one pull request starts one review run: a repeat answers it and fires nothing. Service-to-service only: exact-audience Google ID token from an allowlisted dispatcher.

400.description: Malformed review request

403.description: The caller is not an allowlisted dispatcher

503.description: The caller could not be verified

get.description: Read one bounded keyset page of the mission, session or decision cards agency.facts.v1 carries, each with the revision of its newest fact, with the outbox watermark a replica checkpoints at and the time Agency confirmed the image. Service to service only: a Google ID token for the snapshot audience from an allowlisted service account.

400.description: Unknown relation, cursor minted for another relation, or out-of-range page bound

403.description: The caller is not an allowlisted service account

503.description: The caller could not be verified

get.description:
Read what this workload's purge of one workspace deleted: per domain, when the purge started and finished, each table with the rows it deleted and the rows left, and each provider resource with its handle and whether it was re-observed absent. finished_at stays empty until every table has 0 rows left and every resource is absent. Service-to-service only.

Required scopes: workspace.lifecycle.evidence.

400.description: Invalid workspace id

403.description: Service caller is not authorized

post.description: Open a model relay run for one dedicated job: lease the Anthropic API key of the workspace's organization from Config for this run, and answer the run token once. Service-to-service only: exact-audience Google ID token from an allowlisted dispatcher.

400.description: Malformed run request

403.description: The caller is not an allowlisted dispatcher

409.description: The run is already open, or the organization has no usable key

503.description: The relay is not enabled, or Config is unavailable

post.description: Close a model relay run: its token stops working, and Config's lease records the run's usage and why it stopped. Closing it again answers the recorded close.

400.description: Malformed close request

403.description: The caller is not this run's dispatcher

Authorization: a person's own token, issued by Putnami to putnami.app (aud in agencyAPI.agentSessions.appAudiences, by default app); an API key, a workspace key, a service identity and a delegated token are refused. Membership comes from agency-api's own IAM replica: the read never calls Identity.

get.description: Read one mission page by the mission id alone, as the workspace route answers it, with the mission's workspace_id. The mission's workspace comes from the mission; the route then applies the workspace route's rules there. A mission the caller may not read answers the same 404 as an unknown mission. Authorization: a person's own token, issued by Putnami to putnami.app (aud in agencyAPI.agentSessions.appAudiences, by default app). A token minted from an API key, a workspace key or a delegated token (act claim) is refused, but for one: the MCP surface's child token, whose aud is in agencyAPI.agentSessions.mcpAudiences (none by default), whose act.sub is agencyAPI.agentSessions.mcpActor (by default mcp), whose scope_ref.workspace_id equals the path workspace, and which carries mcp.read on a read or mcp.act on a write; its sub is the person. When the token carries scope_ref.workspace_id, that claim must equal the path workspace. The caller must hold agency.index.read at the path workspace.

400.description: The workspace, a path id, the query string or the body is invalid (code http.bad_request).

403.description: The token's workspace claim names another workspace, the token was minted from an API key, is a workspace key or is a delegated token, or the caller does not hold the route's permission at the path workspace (reason denied). Putnami did not issue the token to putnami.app (aud in agencyAPI.agentSessions.appAudiences, by default app) (reason client). An MCP child token names no workspace or another one, or lacks mcp.read on a read or mcp.act on a write (reason denied); the MCP host's own token, without act, is refused as a token of another client (reason client).

404.description: No mission has the id, or the caller may not read it (reason mission.missing).

503.description: Workspace authorization or the store is unavailable.

post.description: Publish one agent session's state: its mission, plan and state, the messages it received and its replies. The answer carries the mission sheet, plan and open decisions, the messages no session received yet, among them the answers to its decisions, the decision states, where each decision the sync named stands, and what became of each reply: a reply never refuses the sync. The first sync creates the session and, when the caller holds none under the name, the caller's mission. A sync older than the session's last one changes nothing but the acknowledgements and replies, creates nothing, and answers the mission it names. A waiting session polls with wait syncs; a wait that changes nothing writes nothing. One person may sync 120 times a minute. Authorization: a person's own token, issued by Putnami to the putnami CLI (aud in agencyAPI.agentSessions.cliAudiences, by default putnami-cli). A token minted from an API key, a workspace key or a delegated token (act claim) is refused, but for one: the token a session's CLI receives once the person's MCP connection approved its device code, whose aud is in agencyAPI.agentSessions.mcpAudiences, whose act.sub is agent-cli, whose azp is in agencyAPI.agentSessions.cliAudiences, whose scope_ref.workspace_id equals the path workspace, and which carries mcp.read on a read or mcp.act on a write; its sub is the person, and each call it makes is logged with its actor. When the token carries scope_ref.workspace_id, that claim must equal the path workspace. The caller must hold delivery.run.submit at the path workspace. Only the person who owns the mission writes to it.
